plugins.name: outlook-graph
plugins.description: A pack of Outlook skills - Microsoft 365 email and calendar via the Graph API (inbox, reply-all-safe replies, attachments up to 150 MB, calendar and availability), plus offline extraction of PST archives into integrity-verified markdown.

plugins.name: trello

plugins.name: legwork
plugins.description: Multi-source research producing citation-tracked findings - evidence persistence, source credibility scoring and claim-level verification gates. Free built-in search first; paid fallback only when a page genuinely cannot be read.
